title: Hot Spicy Saudi Arabian Lentil Kebabs
description: A spicy and light Saudi Arabian dish made with lentils and ground cinnamon, perfect for a quick fix meal. This recipe is Jain-friendly and can be cooked on a tava-griddle.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
Drain and mash the lentils using a fork or a potato masher.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the ground cinnamon, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mashed lentils to the pan and mix well.
Using your hands, shape the lentil mixture into small kebabs.
Place the kebabs on a preheated tava-griddle and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Serve the kebabs hot with your favorite sauce or chutney.
